scope: bounded read-only Linux inventory; no writes, no /dev/mem, no raw NAND/OOB

commands.name: mtd_and_devices
commands.command: cat /proc/mtd; ls -l /dev/mtd* /dev/mtdblock*; for x in /sys/class/mtd/mtd*/name /sys/class/mtd/mtd*/size /sys/class/mtd/mtd*/ro; do echo ===$x; cat $x 2>/dev/null; done

commands.name: proc_sys
commands.command: find /proc -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; find /sys -maxdepth 4 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei "boot|nand|mtd|firm|recovery|remoteproc|rpmsg|ambarella" | head -300

commands.name: ambarella
commands.command: ls -la /proc/ambarella 2>/dev/null; for f in /proc/ambarella/*; do echo ===$f; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null; done

commands.name: startup_services
commands.command: cat /etc/inittab 2>/dev/null; for f in /etc/init.d/* /etc/rcS.d/* /etc/rc*.d/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo ===$f && sed -n "1,220p" "$f"; done 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei -C 4 "firm|upgrade|boot|recovery|mtd|nand|rtos|rpmsg" | head -500
